name: Project Templates
description: Implement a project template system. Templates define directory structure, config files, default settings, and initial repository setup. Support built-in templates (Node package, Python project, Go service) and user-defined custom templates. Scaffold new projects from a template with variable substitution and post-scaffold hooks.
purpose: Starting new projects should be fast and consistent. Templates encode best practices, standard tooling configuration, and expected structure so every project starts with the right foundation rather than being manually configured from scratch.
acceptanceCriteria: Templates define: directory structure, config files, default settings, pre/post scaffold hooks
Built-in templates include: Node package (TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier), Python project (hatch, ruff), Go service (mod, lint)
User-defined templates can be created from existing projects (save as template)
Scaffolding creates a new project with the template structure at a target path
Variable substitution: template variables ({{name}}, {{description}}, etc.) are replaced during scaffold
Post-scaffold hooks run after file creation (npm install, git init, etc.)
Templates are stored in a well-known location and can be shared across workspaces
Template contents can be previewed without scaffolding
